# Synthetic engineering fixtures

`synthetic-form.json` was independently authored for local implementation tests from the documented supported input shape. It was **not exported from a Typeform account**, and its expected behavior is **not an observation of Typeform**.

The explicit engineering policy retains abandoned drafts and submits only answers on the current route. Other policy settings are tested as local requirements. No test in this directory establishes vendor compatibility, reverse-engineering success, or held-out source accuracy.

Input values are synthetic. Reference captures, if supplied later, must use the separate provenance and verification process described in `docs/EVIDENCE_AND_TESTS.md`.
